author: cms-externals
body:
From @toicca : https://github.com/cms-externals/fastjet-contrib/pull/20 for v1.105

Take out the jet dressing part of GHS from the main run_GHS function. The split in functionality is required, since association of flavoured particles is done in a separate step in CMSSW and we effectively want to have control over [these lines](https://github.com/cms-externals/fastjet-contrib/compare/cms/v1.101...toicca:fastjet-contrib:ghs-dress-jets?expand=1#diff-774e9c0694bbb9cce6db540b19b616d30cb923110a0c2e9ffaffb639ffd8bbc5L310-L323) outside the run_GHS function.

AI generated description of changes:
run_GHS takes the flavour carriers from the jets' own ClusterSequence and associates them through PseudoJet::is_inside. Users whose flavour carriers are not clustered into the jets (e.g. partons or heavy-flavour hadrons used to dress hadron-level jets) need the dressing step alone, with their own jet association.

Expose that step as dress_jets_GHS(jets, flavoured_inputs, alpha, omega, flav_recombiner): flavoured inputs carry a FlavHistory and a user_index of 0 (unassociated) or -(i+1) (associated with jets[i]). run_GHS now prepares its inputs as before and calls it; its output is unchanged (example-GHS.ref, make check 45/45). CMSSW NanoAOD gives identical results with this function instead of its private copy of the GHS core.
title: GHSAlgo: add dress_jets_GHS for given jets and flavoured inputs
